title: Venezuelan Corn Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful Venezuelan-inspired snack made with corn, zesty flavors, and a hint of spice.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, onion, zesty pepper sauce, egg, tagine spice, salt, and black pepper.
Add corn kernels and mix until well combined.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the corn mixture into balls.
Heat 1-2 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add the corn balls and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
